# Now 2.10.48
- Fixed Chrome extension communication with the native app by moving localhost requests into an extension service worker. - Preserved strict YouTube Music origin validation and a narrowly scoped localhost permission. - Bundled Chrome extension 1.3.0 so real queue diagnostics can reach the native app reliably.

# Now 2.10.47
- Expanded the Chrome extension’s YouTube Music queue reader with rendered Up Next rows. - Removed the misleading self-cover substitution when adjacent artwork is unavailable. - Added a local diagnostic timeline for private queue APIs, playlist state, rendered rows, and resolution paths. - Bundled Chrome extension 1.2.0 for precise adjacent-artwork troubleshooting.

# Now 2.10.46
- Added an optional Chrome extension that provides real previous and next YouTube Music artwork during trackpad swipes. - Added a private, localhost-only bridge between the extension and the native app. - Made swipe gestures responsive across every music source, including Apple Music, with a graceful elastic fallback when queue artwork is unavailable. - Added guided Chrome-extension installation to Settings and bundled the extension inside the app.
